newsitem.title: USA: Cobra Golf names Dubiel President, CEO.
newsitem.headline: Cobra Golf names Dubiel President, CEO.

text.p: Cobra Golf Inc Wednesday said it named Robert Dubiel as president and chief executive officer, following the resignations of the company's chief executive officer and its chief operating officer.

In a statement, the company said Mark McClure, who had served as chief executive officer since April 1990, has resigned to pursue other opportunities and Dave Schaefer, chief operating officer, has also resigned.
Dubiel had served as president and chief operating officer of Cobra Golf's sister company, Titleist and Foot-Joy Worldwide, since January 1996.

The company also said Thomas Crow, co-founder and vice chairman emeritus, will resume a more active role in the company and Steve Pelisek is now vice president of sales. Pelisek was formerly the director of sales and marketing for Titleist golf clubs.
Jim Vincent Sr., who was vice president of sales, has been named vice president of national sales.
Graham Guy, managing director of Acushnet U.K. Ltd, will now have full responsibility for all Titleist and Foot-Joy Worldwide and Cobra Golf operations outside the Americas.
Cobra designs, manufactures and markets golf clubs principally for the premium-priced game-improvement segment of the golf-equipment market.
